Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: Initial public release of the Russian-language Windows desktop client for Kpshka.ru.
Program_Info.Program_System_Requirements: Windows 10 or Windows 11, x64 only. Internet connection required. The .NET runtime is bundled; no separate runtime installation is required.

English.Keywords: tender search,procurement,supplier proposals,business messaging,Russian procurement,Windows,portable application
English.Char_Desc_45: Free tender search for Windows 10/11 x64
English.Char_Desc_80: Free Russian tender-search and procurement client for Windows 10/11 x64
English.Char_Desc_250: Kpshka Desktop is a Russian-language Windows 10/11 x64 client for tender search, procurement and company messaging. All app and platform features are free; there are no paid plans. Runs as one EXE without a separate installation.
English.Char_Desc_450: Kpshka Desktop provides tender search, saved templates, favorites, procurement procedures and company messaging in one Windows application. The interface is Russian. All app and platform features are free; there are no paid plans. Windows 10/11 x64 and internet are required. Official website: https://kpshka.ru/
English.Char_Desc_2000: Kpshka Desktop is a Russian-language application for tender search and business procurement on Windows. Search by keywords, region, procurement law, dates and price. Save useful tenders in favorites and reuse saved search templates. The Kpshka.ru platform also supports procurement procedures, questions, supplier proposals and company messaging. Use the same account on the website and in the desktop client. All application and platform features are free. There are no paid plans. An account is needed for account-based workflows; an internet connection is required. Version 0.1.0 supports Windows 10 and Windows 11 x64. A single portable EXE runs without a separate installation, with the .NET runtime bundled. This is proprietary freeware, not an open-source release. Official website: https://kpshka.ru/ Application and download page: https://kpshka.ru/apps
